grammar.pattern: all + 都 · 一起 / 一块儿 + action
grammar.explanation: 都 refers to every member of a stated group and normally precedes the verb: 我们都去. 一起 and colloquial 一块儿 say people act together; they do not by themselves say that every possible person comes. Compare 我们都回家 with 我们一起回家: everyone goes home versus going home together.

examples.zh: 我们都想走，有些朋友想跑。
examples.py: wǒ men dōu xiǎng zǒu , yǒu xiē péng you xiǎng pǎo .
examples.en: We all want to walk; some friends want to run.

examples.zh: 我们一起走，也一块儿聊天。
examples.py: wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu , yě yī kuàir liáo tiān .
examples.en: We walk together and chat together.

commonMistakes.why: Place 都 before the verb it modifies.

grammar.explanation: Related clauses can be placed together without a connector: 我开门，你出来. 一边…一边… coordinates simultaneous activities by the same actor, such as walking and chatting. It does not mean “first…then”. 也 adds a parallel action or fact: 我想走，也想聊天. Choose activities that can actually happen together and keep street safety in mind.

examples.py: wǒ kāi mén , nǐ chū lái .
examples.en: I will open the door; you come out.

examples.py: wǒ men yī biān zǒu , yī biān liáo tiān .
examples.en: We walk and chat at the same time.

examples.zh: 我想散步，也想听你说话。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng sàn bù , yě xiǎng tīng nǐ shuō huà .
examples.en: I want to take a walk and also hear you speak.

commonMistakes.why: Attending class and sleeping are not the intended simultaneous actions; use 先…再… for the sequence.

dialogue.title: Walk after the call
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the safe shared activity and the time to return.

lines.zh: 我们一块儿出门吧。有些朋友也想去。
lines.py: wǒ men yī kuàir chū mén ba . yǒu xiē péng you yě xiǎng qù .
lines.en: Let us go out together. Some friends want to come too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，我先打电话，再出来。你等一下儿。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ xiān dǎ diàn huà , zài chū lái . nǐ děng yī xiàr .
lines.en: Okay. I will call first, then come out. Wait a moment.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我在楼下。我开门，你出来。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ zài lóu xià . wǒ kāi mén , nǐ chū lái .
lines.en: Okay, I am downstairs. I will open the door; you come out.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我听到你说话了。你在门口吗？
lines.py: wǒ tīng dào nǐ shuō huà le . nǐ zài mén kǒu ma ?
lines.en: I heard you speaking. Are you at the doorway?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 在。我们都想走，不跑。
lines.py: zài . wǒ men dōu xiǎng zǒu , bù pǎo .
lines.en: Yes. We all want to walk, without running.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我也想散步，一边走，一边聊天。
lines.py: wǒ yě xiǎng sàn bù , yī biān zǒu , yī biān liáo tiān .
lines.en: I also want a walk; we can walk and chat.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你听见旁边有人唱歌吗？
lines.py: nǐ tīng jiàn páng biān yǒu rén chàng gē ma ?
lines.en: Do you hear someone singing nearby?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 听见了，但没有听懂。我想再听一次。
lines.py: tīng jiàn le , dàn méi yǒu tīng dǒng . wǒ xiǎng zài tīng yī cì .
lines.en: Yes, but I did not understand it. I would like to listen again.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先过马路，过了再听。别一边走一边看手机。
lines.py: xiān guò mǎ lù , guò le zài tīng . bié yī biān zǒu yī biān kàn shǒu jī .
lines.en: Cross the road first, then listen. Do not look at your phone while walking.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。七点我回到家，先回去做晚饭。
lines.py: hǎo . qī diǎn wǒ huí dào jiā , xiān huí qù zuò wǎn fàn .
lines.en: Okay. I will be home at seven and go back to make dinner first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你什么时候回来？
lines.py: nǐ shén me shí hou huí lái ?
lines.en: When are you coming back?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 八点再来。你们先走，我也想和大家一起走。
lines.py: bā diǎn zài lái . nǐ men xiān zǒu , wǒ yě xiǎng hé dà jiā yì qǐ zǒu .
lines.en: I will come again at eight. You go on first; I also want to walk with everyone.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Walk plan in the group chat
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find which actions are simultaneous and which happen in order.

lines.zh: 今天有些朋友想出门，我们一块儿走一会儿。
lines.py: jīn tiān yǒu xiē péng you xiǎng chū mén , wǒ men yī kuàir zǒu yī huì er .
lines.en: Some friends want to go out today; we will walk together for a while.

lines.zh: 我先打电话，再出来，请大家等一下儿。
lines.py: wǒ xiān dǎ diàn huà , zài chū lái , qǐng dà jiā děng yī xiàr .
lines.en: I will call first, then come out; please wait a moment.

lines.zh: 朋友开门，我从家里出来，在楼下见面。
lines.py: péng you kāi mén , wǒ cóng jiā lǐ chū lái , zài lóu xià jiàn miàn .
lines.en: A friend opens the door; I come out of my home and we meet downstairs.

lines.zh: 我们都想散步，一边走，一边聊天，不跑。
lines.py: wǒ men dōu xiǎng sàn bù , yī biān zǒu , yī biān liáo tiān , bù pǎo .
lines.en: We all want a walk; we will walk and chat, without running.

lines.zh: 我听到朋友说话，也听见旁边有人唱歌。
lines.py: wǒ tīng dào péng you shuō huà , yě tīng jiàn páng biān yǒu rén chàng gē .
lines.en: I hear my friend speaking and also hear someone singing nearby.

lines.zh: 听见不一定听懂，我们过马路以后再听。
lines.py: tīng jiàn bù yí dìng tīng dǒng , wǒ men guò mǎ lù yǐ hòu zài tīng .
lines.en: Hearing does not necessarily mean understanding; we will listen again after crossing the road.

lines.zh: 七点我回到家，先回去做晚饭。
lines.py: qī diǎn wǒ huí dào jiā , xiān huí qù zuò wǎn fàn .
lines.en: I will be home at seven and go back to make dinner first.

lines.zh: 八点我回来，和朋友一起走，也一起说汉语。
lines.py: bā diǎn wǒ huí lái , hé péng you yì qǐ zǒu , yě yì qǐ shuō hàn yǔ .
lines.en: I will come back at eight to walk with friends and speak Chinese together.

choices: To give attention to crossing safely
questions.answer: To give attention to crossing safely

extraReadings.title: A sound is not its meaning
extraReadings.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow a brief original street-side conversation.

lines.zh: 我听见有人唱歌，你听到了吗？
lines.py: wǒ tīng jiàn yǒu rén chàng gē , nǐ tīng dào le ma ?
lines.en: I hear someone singing. Did you hear it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 听到了，没听懂。先走，不跑。
lines.py: tīng dào le , méi tīng dǒng . xiān zǒu , bù pǎo .
lines.en: I heard it but did not understand. Walk first; do not run.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们一边走，一边聊天，行吗？
lines.py: wǒ men yī biān zǒu , yī biān liáo tiān , xíng ma ?
lines.en: Can we walk and chat?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，但过马路的时候先不聊天。
lines.py: xíng , dàn guò mǎ lù de shí hou xiān bù liáo tiān .
lines.en: Yes, but pause the chat when crossing the road.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 七点回到家，八点再出来，一块儿走。
lines.py: qī diǎn huí dào jiā , bā diǎn zài chū lái , yī kuàir zǒu .
lines.en: Home at seven, out again at eight to walk together.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我先回去，你也回吧。等一下儿再说。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ xiān huí qù , nǐ yě huí ba . děng yī xiàr zài shuō .
lines.en: Okay, I will go back first; you go back too. We will talk again in a moment.
lines.speaker: b
